text: I need to verify if there was a delay in passing meconium during the first two days of life, as this is a critical clue. Additionally, has a barium enema or abdominal X-ray been performed to check for a transition zone or dilated bowel loops?

text: The X-ray findings of dilated bowel loops with an absent rectal gas shadow are highly suggestive of Hirschsprung disease, especially given the history of feeding difficulties and abdominal distension. I would like to perform a digital rectal examination to assess for a tight anal sphincter or a sudden release of gas and stool upon withdrawal. REQUEST IMAGES
